dialogue_texts: The air is getting incredibly dense out here. We may be getting closer to the Shirogane Manor...
But this distortion is making a five-minute walk feel like an eternity.
The glohm isn't just warping - it's actively rejecting our presence.
The closer we get to the center, the more aggressive the glohm will become.
Stray variables... Intruders tracking dirt across the threshold of a flawless equation.
Great, another roadblock. Look, we're in a hurry to stop the glohm from descending outward.
If you're just here to stand in the way, step aside before I have to force you.
Just look at her signatures, Your Honor.
Helene Black may still retain her physical appearance, but she's completely overtaken by the glohm.
Her core is fluctuating wildly. She won't listen to you.
The axes must be shattered so the true foundation can rise.
You speak of saving a world that is already structurally redundant.
I don't care about your equations or foundations.
I care about fixing this incident so I can go back to my shrine and have a quiet evening.
If your axes are in the way, I'll just have to break them myself.
Let me see if your amulets can withstand the pressure of the glohm!
